official_domain_search.query: "Vermont Psychiatric Care Hospital" Berlin VT standard charges price transparency
official_domain_search.basis: https://mentalhealth.vermont.gov/programs-services/vermont-psychiatric-care-hospital is the first-party DMH page for the state-operated Vermont Psychiatric Care Hospital (25-bed acute care hospital).

site_map_walk: https://mentalhealth.vermont.gov/programs-services/vermont-psychiatric-care-hospital (VPCH page: mission/vision/contact/careers/advisory only; no pricing or standard-charges link)
https://mentalhealth.vermont.gov/policy-resources/financial-transparency (points to spotlight.vermont.gov state finances; no hospital MRF)
other_official_routes_checked: https://auditor.vermont.gov/content/hospital-price-transparency-pages (200) lists hospital price-transparency pages but does not include Vermont Psychiatric Care Hospital
what_changed_vs_prior_evidence: Prior state (2026-09-23) was discovery-pointer-not-retrieved. This pass the current DMH site (redesigned Drupal with new URL structure) was walked per the recorded next_action and confirmed to contain no VPCH standard-charges page, no hospital MRF link, and no root pointer (cms-hpt.txt 404); the State Auditor's hospital transparency index also omits VPCH.
established: The current first-party Vermont DMH site exposes no facility-identified MRF or standard-charges page for VPCH as of this observation.
not_established: Whether a current MRF exists off-site or behind a publisher-provided file; the file's absence on the site map is not proof of noncompliance.
tool_vs_inference: Page contents and the 404 are direct tool observations. The absence conclusion is an inference bounded by the three pages and one index walked.
next_action: Obtain a publisher-provided current CSV/JSON (e.g., via the DMH contact/public-records channel listed on the site) or await a published transparency page; then verify exact facility identity, Vermont metadata, declared date/version and usable bytes before promotion.
